summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income subsidies provided by public utilities or governments for water conservation, storm water management, and wastewater management measures, making these rebates tax-free.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the types of conservation subsidies that are excluded from gross income for tax purposes. By making these subsidies non-taxable, it effectively lowers the tax burden for individuals receiving them, thus reducing government tax revenue.

The bill expands an existing tax exclusion under IRC section 136 to cover water conservation, stormwater, and wastewater subsidies/rebates, making those amounts nontaxable. This reduces federal tax revenue and therefore increases the deficit; the entire bill is devoted to this revenue-losing tax change.
